\section{Introduction}
\subsection{Purpose}
This document specifies the software requirements for \textbf{MedBook} -- an online medical appointment booking platform serving patients, doctors, receptionists, and hospital administrators.

\subsection{Scope}
The system supports: doctor search, book/cancel/reschedule appointments, medical record management, safety warnings, insurance verification, and operational reporting.

\section{Overall Description}
\subsection{Product Perspective}
MedBook is a web/mobile system connecting patients to healthcare providers, replacing the traditional phone-based booking process.

\subsection{User Classes and Characteristics}
\begin{longtable}{|l|l|p{9cm}|}
\hline
\textbf{ID} & \textbf{User Class} & \textbf{Primary Role / Benefit} \\ \hline
\endhead
SH-01 & Patient & Book appointments quickly, view history, receive reminders \\ \hline
SH-02 & Doctor & Manage schedule, view medical records, drug interaction warnings \\ \hline
SH-03 & Receptionist / Front desk staff & Confirm bookings, handle cancel/reschedule, assist walk-ins \\ \hline
SH-04 & Hospital Administrator & Manage doctor/department catalog, operational reports, access control \\ \hline
SH-05 & Health insurance provider & Verify insurance coverage, reconcile costs \\ \hline

\subsection{General Constraints}
Must comply with personal health-data protection regulations; limited infrastructure budget for phase 1; 4-month delivery timeline.


\section{Functional Requirements}
\subsection{FR-001 -- Patient account registration and login}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow patients to register via email/phone and verify via OTP.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-01
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-01
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-002 -- Search doctors by specialty/location}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow searching doctors by specialty, name, rating, and location.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-01
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-02
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-003 -- Book an appointment online}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow patients to select a doctor and an available time slot to book.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-01
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Approved
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-03
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-004 -- Cancel / reschedule an appointment}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow patients to cancel or reschedule at least 2 hours in advance.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-01
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Approved
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-04
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-005 -- Receptionist confirms appointment}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow the receptionist to confirm or reject a booking request.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-03
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-05
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-006 -- Appointment reminder via email/SMS}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall automatically send reminders 24 hours and 1 hour in advance.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-01
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-06
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-007 -- Doctor views and updates medical records}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow doctors to view visit history and record new results.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-02
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Approved
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-07
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-008 -- Drug interaction / allergy warning}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall warn doctors when a prescription conflicts with a known allergy.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-02
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-08
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-009 -- Manage doctor and department catalog}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall allow admins to add/edit/remove doctor and specialty records.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-04
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\item \textbf{Status}: Approved
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-09
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-010 -- Visit statistics report}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall export reports on booking/cancellation counts by day/month.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-04
\item \textbf{Priority}: Low
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-10
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-011 -- Verify health insurance coverage}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall call a partner insurance API to check policy validity.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-05
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\item \textbf{Status}: Proposed
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-11
\end{itemize}

\subsection{FR-012 -- Role-based access control (RBAC)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Description}: The system shall restrict features by role: patient/doctor/receptionist/admin.
\item \textbf{Related stakeholder}: SH-06
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\item \textbf{Status}: Approved
\item \textbf{Related use case}: UC-12
\end{itemize}


\section{Non-functional Requirements}
\subsection{NFR-001 -- Performance (Performance)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: Doctor-search page response time $\le$ 2s with 500 concurrent users.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Load testing
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-002 -- Availability (Availability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The system shall achieve $\ge$ 99.5\% monthly uptime (excluding scheduled maintenance).
\item \textbf{Verification method}: 30-day uptime monitoring
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-003 -- Security (Security)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: Medical record data shall be encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Configuration review + penetration test
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-004 -- Data privacy (Privacy/Compliance)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The system shall follow data-minimization principles for personal data.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Compliance checklist review
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-005 -- Scalability (Scalability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The system shall handle 3x booking volume growth over 12 months without architecture changes.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Incremental load testing
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-006 -- Usability (Usability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: A first-time user shall complete their first booking in $\le$ 3 minutes without guidance.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Usability testing
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-007 -- Safety (Safety)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The system shall raise a conflict warning within $\le$ 1 second when a doctor double-booking is detected.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Booking-conflict scenario testing
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-008 -- Recoverability (Reliability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The system shall recover booking data within 15 minutes after an incident (RPO$\le$5min, RTO$\le$15min).
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Disaster-recovery drill
\item \textbf{Priority}: High
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-009 -- Maintainability (Maintainability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: Source code shall achieve $\ge$ 80\% unit-test coverage for the booking module.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: CI coverage report
\item \textbf{Priority}: Medium
\end{itemize}

\subsection{NFR-010 -- Compatibility (Compatibility/Portability)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{SMART measurement criterion}: The UI shall work correctly on Chrome, Safari, Edge versions released in the last 2 years.
\item \textbf{Verification method}: Cross-browser testing
\item \textbf{Priority}: Low
\end{itemize}


\section{Design Constraints}
\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Technical Constraint}: The system must be developed using a RESTful microservices architecture, with all APIs communicating via JSON over HTTPS. The user interface must support responsive web design ensuring usability on mobile screens with a minimum viewport width of 360px. Electronic medical data integration must adhere to HL7/FHIR release 4 standards.
\item \textbf{Legal and Regulatory Constraint}: The system and databases must be hosted on cloud infrastructure situated within data centers in Vietnam, strictly complying with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection and the Vietnam Law on Medical Examination and Treatment (2023). All electronic medical records and PII (Personally Identifiable Information) must be encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
\item \textbf{Timeline and Budget Constraint}: The MVP (Minimum Viable Product) release must be delivered within 4 months from project kickoff. Cloud infrastructure hosting costs for Phase 1 must not exceed the approved operational budget limit of 150 million VND per annum.
\end{enumerate}
